name: Chicken
overview: The Bible uses imagery related to chickens to reveal both God's protective care and human frailty. Jesus likens His desire to gather and protect His people to a hen gathering her chicks under her wings, expressing tender, maternal care (Matthew 23:37; Luke 13:34). This metaphor contrasts with human rejection of that care. Additionally, the crowing of the cock serves as a prophetic sign of Peter's denial of Christ, highlighting human weakness and the fulfillment of Jesus' words (Matthew 26:34; Luke 22:34). The mention of fowls prepared as food (Nehemiah 5:18) and the Psalmist's depiction of God covering His people with feathers (Psalm 91:4) further emphasize themes of provision and divine protection.
